scope: Planning recipes over exact locally extracted events. This file is not an indexer, event dataset, RPC configuration, completeness claim, or current-state source.

recipes.purpose: Index original rescues, Genesis batches, adoption offers/requests, cancellations, and completed adoptions without treating history as current state.
identifierGuidance: Do not infer rescueOrder without a separate reviewed lookup.

startBoundary.note: No deployment block is present in the reviewed local registry evidence; configure only from separately verified evidence.

exclusions: complete historical coverage without a verified scan boundary

operationalGuidance.checkpointing: Persist the last finalized block plus transactionHash/logIndex identities; replay from a safety margin after restart.
operationalGuidance.reorgAndFinality: Treat unfinalized logs as provisional, remove replaced logs, and make writes idempotent by transactionHash plus logIndex.
operationalGuidance.liveStateBoundary: Recipes describe zero-network planning from checked-in evidence. They do not provide logs, RPC access, completeness, freshness, or current state.

maintainedIndex.useDirectLogsWhen: Building or independently auditing raw history with separately authorized chain access and reorg-safe storage.
maintainedIndex.useMaintainedFinalizedIndexWhen: A revision-bounded finalized current name, canonical finalized CatNamed history, naming order/year, namer, or blank-event history is sufficient.

exclusions: event presence as proof of current name
rewriting raw bytes32 during display moderation

recipes.purpose: Index definition creation/management and assignment events while acknowledging that the exact ABI has no event for every mutable wear-state transition.
identifierGuidance: Use mooncatRescueOrder for on-chain rescueOrder fields; keep it distinct from localRescueOrderIndex, accessoryId, paletteIndex, ownedAccessoryIndex, and zIndex.
zIndex is render/wear order, not an identifier; zero means owned but not worn in reviewed state semantics.

startBoundary.note: A reviewed deployment transaction/timestamp is retained, but the block remains unknown and must not be inferred.

exclusions: current accessory ownership or wear state
complete reconstruction of palette/zIndex alterations from logs
taxonomy, image bytes, current prices, supply, or eligibility
recipes.incompleteness: The exact ABI contains no dedicated event for alterAccessory/alterAccessories, so event-only indexing cannot reconstruct every paletteIndex or zIndex mutation.
